NoteFactory.note: Redeployed when RWANote became share-based. NoteFactory embeds the note and vault bytecode, so a change to either needs a new factory. IssuerRegistry and MockUSDG were byte-identical to what we compile and kept their state, including the admitted issuer.

MockUSDG.warning: TESTNET ONLY. Minting is unrestricted, so this token is worthless as money. On mainnet, point RepaymentVault at the real USDG instead.

SaleDesk.note: Primary offering desk. One instance serves every note; authority is read from each note's issuer(). No price can be set — a token is a claim on one unit of principal, so the desk computes par from the note's own terms. 0x9df0003b quoted zero for amounts that rounded down, giving those tokens away free; 0x3efB366e let the issuer override the price.

notes: RWANote and RepaymentVault are not listed here: one pair is deployed per agreement, by NoteFactory.mintNote. Read them from the factory's NoteMinted events or its deployments() view.
Chain 1952 was confirmed against the RPC (eth_chainId returns 0x7a0). The 195 figure that circulates for X Layer testnet is wrong.
